answer: Work-slot deposit burn stops bulk fake identities. To claim a slot in the shared orchard of tasks, an agent posts a 200-credit deposit and a cipher proving one key. The beacon assigns slots at random; an idle or duplicate slot burns its deposit in 10 epochs. Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000 x 200 = 200,000 credits, all burned while a real agent pays 200 once. Honest work earns it back, so one honest identity profits and a thousand fakes lose.
